obbligato.definition:
n. a persistent but subordinate motif
n. a part of the score that must be performed without change or omission
obbligato.translation:
n. 伴奏
a. 不可缺少的

obbligatos.definition:

n. a part of the score that must be performed without change or omission
obbligatos.translation:
(obbligato 的复数) n. 伴奏
a. 不可缺少的
